Bug_Title: BOA: Class overrides a method implemented in super class Adapter wrongly (BOA_BADLY_OVERRIDDEN_ADAPTER)
Bug_Details:
This method overrides a method found in a parent class, where that class is an Adapter that implements
a listener defined in the java.awt.event or javax.swing.event package. As a result, this method will not
get called when the event occurs.
Bug_Explanation: This bug is about overriding a method of the Adapter class. The class Adapter is an abstract class and it implements MouseListener interface. The method'mouseClicked' is overridden but for'mouseEntered' and'mouseExited' which are not overridden which violates the contract of the Adapter class. As a result, the event handlers might not get called.
